data.name: Amr
data.gender_notes: Amr is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amr is a Quranic name that means 'command' or 'order'. It is often associated with the concept of divine guidance and strength. The name Amr carries the meaning “Command, Order, Strength” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amr usually hope their child will grow to embody command, order, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

We make no distinction between any of them, and unto Him we have surrendered.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amr is of significant cultural importance in the Islamic world, as it is the name of several prominent figures in Islamic history who have played a crucial role in the spread and establishment of the Islamic faith. One such figure is Imam 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (r.a.), the fourth Rightly-Guided Caliphs of Islam and the cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). He was renowned for his courage and leadership abilities, which he demonstrated in various battles and conflicts during his time. Another notable figure with the name Amr was Amr Ibn Al-'As, a rooted companion of Prophet Muhammad (p.b.u.h) who played a crucial role in early Muslim conquests by leading various military campaigns.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Amr takes on deeper meaning as it is a reminder of Allah's ultimate command and authority over all things. The name represents the idea that everything in the universe, including the human being, is ultimately under Allah's control, and that we should submit ourselves to His will. It is also a reminder of the importance of obedience to Allah's commands and guidance, as contained in the Quran and the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (p.b.u.h). The name Amr can inspire a sense of obedience, courage, and determination, as one strives to fulfill Allah's commands and live a righteous and devout life.
